flowName: OGB - Governed Outlook Service Request Intake
trigger: When a new email arrives in a shared mailbox (V2)
prohibitedActions: Dataverse Add a new row for cr664_dealtask1
attachmentHandling: Retrieve an attachment individually only after malware scanning and only when a separately approved document-intake policy requires it.
duplicateHandling: The Dataverse Custom API uses mailbox plus InternetMessageId and a deterministic native GUID. Connector duplicate delivery must return duplicate without creating a second task.
